continuity: Namgung Ryong is the Family Head of the Namgung family and has committed its intelligence network to investigating Jin Taekyung.
The Hidden Thread is a centuries-old intelligence network loyal only to the Family Head; the Lesser Threads operate beneath it as informants.
Jeok Cheongang and Jin Taekyung have reached Mount Jiuhua in Anhui after a fifteen-day forced march from Shanxi through Henan.
Jeok plans to subject Taekyung to six months of daily training at the greatest intensity a human can endure.
Jeok forced Taekyung to sleep for two shichen by using Pressure-Point Strike on his Sleep Acupoint.
Jeok experienced sudden weakness after using substantial strength and acknowledged that he does not have much time.
plot: Namgung Ryong, Family Head of the Namgung family, learns that Fire King Jeok Cheongang has returned to Mount Jiuhua with a new Disciple, Jin Taekyung. He orders the Hidden Thread to mobilize every Lesser Thread and uncover everything about Taekyung within a month.

After a fifteen-day forced march from Shanxi through Henan to Anhui, Taekyung and Jeok reach the base of Mount Jiuhua. Taekyung begs for one proper meal and a chance to wash before six months of extreme training, but Jeok binds him with Seizing an Object Through Empty Space, strikes his Sleep Acupoint, and forces him to sleep. Afterward, Jeok suffers a sudden bout of weakness, realizes he has little time, and carries Taekyung toward Mount Jiuhua.

profile_creations.personality: Authoritative, calculating, decisive, and conscious of the Namgung family’s position as a Murim hegemon.
profile_creations.relationships: Family Head of the Namgung family; commands the Hidden Thread and the Lesser Threads.
profile_creations.role: Family Head of the Namgung family; he has led the family for nearly twenty years and orders its intelligence network to investigate Jin Taekyung after learning that Jeok Cheongang has returned to Mount Jiuhua with Taekyung as his new Disciple.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Over-one-hundred-year-old wandering martial master and the Fire King; he visits Jang Taebo’s home, can detect Qi Sense, can cross more than ten jang in an instant, plans to reach Taiyuan and visit the Lower District Sect while concealing his identity, and once fought Sword Saint Mae Jonghak for seven days and seven nights to a draw at Mount Jiuhua before emerging from seclusion and annihilating one thousand Demonic Cultists there; after striking Jin Taekyung with the Flame Divine Palm, he deduces that Taekyung took the Blazing Flame Divine Pill and confronts him when he tries to flee the inn; he reaches the Jin Family of Taiyuan, falsely identifies the Unnamed Sword in public as the Fire Gate Clan’s sacred treasure entrusted to Taekyung, later reveals that it is actually the Fire Heaven Sword, the beloved sword of the Fire Gate Clan’s tenth Sect Leader, uses Six-Harmonies Voice Transmission to stop Song Il, publicly humiliates him, then follows the departing Zhongnan group, incapacitates the Three Hands, breaks Song Il’s wrist, strikes him with the Flame Divine Palm, and threatens to destroy the Zhongnan Sect and Mount Zhongnan if Taekyung or the Jin Family is harmed; two days later, he severely beats Taekyung with his bare fists over the partly burned Flame Divine Palm manual, performs an abbreviated cleansing treatment on Taekyung, discovers his exceptionally balanced body, and suspects he may possess the legendary Heavenly Martial Physique; at the Jin Family banquet, after Ak Bulgun questions their relationship, he publicly declares himself the eighteenth Sect Leader of the Fire Gate Clan, accepts Taekyung as his Disciple, and declares that Taekyung will inherit the clan’s orthodox lineage; he identifies Taekyung as possessing the Heavenly Martial Physique, agrees to personally oversee Taekyung’s martial-arts training until Taekyung reaches a certain level, and permits Taekyung to address him as Master publicly and Old Master in private while continuing to deny that they are truly master and Disciple; after accepting Taekyung’s challenge to defend only, he is forced five steps backward by Taekyung’s One Annihilation and admits defeat, then supports Taekyung with internal energy as he collapses; impressed by the strike, he now desires to guide Taekyung toward becoming a Heavenly Dragon; he successfully forces open Taekyung’s Conception and Governor Vessels, then carries the unconscious Taekyung away to rest after the ordeal; he waits through Taekyung’s seven-day unconscious recovery, explains that removing accumulated turbid qi caused the adjustment period, discusses the Star-Array Grand Banquet invitation, and asks Taekyung to visit his quarters at dawn after hearing Taekyung’s desire to pursue greater strength; he now takes Taekyung away immediately for a year of martial-arts training in Anhui; after the seven-day journey from Taiyuan to Luoyang, he effortlessly defeats Heukgeol and compels the Dongcheon Sect’s fighters to withdraw without killing them.
